scope: Full Lattice source suite with the pinned SDK source dependency and repaired guarded SDK transport
admission: Local tests and planted processes only; no model prompt, native tool action, production database, or network route.
unit: One source-suite invocation with retained incremental output. Interruption requires a new identity; no partial pass is inferred.
pass_action: Retain source and dependency compatibility evidence; continue native permission and installed qualification separately.
fail_action: Preserve the first failure and repair the implicated source before a successor.
proof_limit: Not native action enforcement, same-user credential isolation, installed approval routing, or English semantic qualification.
